scope: Instance-by-instance inventory of the 32-sheet architectural set (Vivid Design & Drafting, project 042224, Lot 735 / 15 Leichhardt Ave, Burnside Heights), each item compared with the uninstalled 0.3.3 Blender candidate (current-model-objects.jsonl, 8624 objects), the build/VR scripts, the installed 0.3.2 gallery and the Unity sun code. Conventions: T/B/L/R = top/bottom/left/right of the floor-plan sheets; true cardinal per north arrow and elevation titles is L=North, T=East, R=South, B=West. 'objs' = current-model-objects.jsonl; 'gal' = output/vr/review-0.3.2; 'bf:N' = scripts/build_frame.py line N; 'NONE' = no matching object name or material in objs and nothing visible in gal (rooms are bare lined shells). Model X runs L to R from the garage outer face, Y runs B to T, Z is up; FF structural level is 3.140, finished deck 3.159.
limitations: Read-only tools: nothing was run in Blender or Unity; model evidence is object names, materials and bounds text plus gallery images.
Many box objects in objs report unit-cube local bounds (-0.5..0.5), so slabs and some framing could not be measured.
pdftoppm is not installed, so the PDF could not be re-rendered; sheets were read as downsampled (about 2000 px) PNGs plus text. Small labels and plotted positions are approximate.
Sheets 1, 2, 5, 13, 23, 24, 25, 28 and 30 were read from text only; sheet 20 text is empty and was read visually.
Engineering, truss and floor-truss shop drawings were not reviewed; only an engineering text grep for the theatre platform was done.
gal is the installed 0.3.2 build; objs is the 0.3.3 candidate. The C2 post shift (-405.7 mm) and W10 shift (-250 mm) are provisional and are flagged, not accepted.
Opening positions along walls are pixel-traced in build_frame.py; only sizes, sill and head heights were checked from bounds.
My cross-checks of the house X datum, alfresco pier spacing and FF door positions are arithmetic from dimension chains and script coordinates, not measurements; confidence is marked accordingly.
Electrical points were not located one by one; counts are from the sheet 14 legend and positions are approximate reads.
Downpipe correspondence between sheets 3, 4, 7 and 8 is by plotted position only.
position_audit.json figures refer to the earlier timber-frame file, not necessarily the VR candidate.
No plan gives a theatre platform or step height; none is inferred here.
